changelog_from_0_1_0: Fixed goalkeeper screenshot count: one per game WON (not per game played) within the series — corrects a bug in PRD §8.3 and FRD FR-GK-007
Replaced cross-screen statistical goalkeeper identity matching with caption-based nickname fuzzy matching (FR-GK-005)
All goalkeeper records are now award-eligible by construction (no more 'retained but ineligible' state)
Resolved O-001 through O-015; see DECISIONS.md section D for full resolutions
Group sizing confirmed: batches of 5, remainder absorbed as groups of 4; qualifiers fixed at 2 per group regardless of size
Tied KO game replay now explicitly adds into existing series score rather than an ambiguous 'replay' with no persistence rule
Room host policy replaced 'alternating host' with 'advisory left-side default + opponent-substitution + forfeit-on-refusal'
New double-room-card-unavailable rule: Group Stage = double walkover (0 pts each), Knockout = mandatory reschedule
Verax media integration changed from 'reuse existing service' to 'separate instance, pattern reference only' for editorial/tournament media isolation
AI provider policy confirmed: Groq + Gemini + Ollama Cloud, rotated/load-balanced, all free tier
Report session expiry extension capped at 3 occurrences
Award formulas simplified to single-metric ranking (no weighted composite formulas)

New FR-COMP-013: left/right side assignment in Group Stage fixtures must be balanced per team (standard round-robin satisfies this), so no single team is disproportionately the default room host across the Group Stage — added new fixtures.left_side_team_id and host_assignment_reason fields to DATA_MODEL.md
